keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «타라가 정글에서 길을 잃었다(문제)» 와 «똑똑한 앵무새가 타라가 돌아오도록 도와주었다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Tara is lost in the jungle) and the solution (a clever parrot helps her find her way back). The green sentences are the answers.

boxes.a: Tara is lost in the jungle, and she is hot, tired, and scared.
A red parrot says "Follow me!" and leads her back to her camp.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

sum.pre: says, "Follow me!" Tara follows it over a
. The clever parrot helped her find her way back.

words: a hot forest with many tall trees and plants
Tall trees are everywhere, and strange birds call.
Then a red parrot lands on a branch.
a colorful bird that can say words
Tara follows the parrot over a river and under big leaves.
a place with tents where people stay outside
A clever parrot helped Tara find her way back.

qs.q: Why does Tara follow the parrot?
opts: She wants to catch the parrot.
evs: Tall trees are everywhere, and strange birds call.
why: 앵무새가 «따라와! 따라와!» 하고 말해요. 그래서 타라가 앵무새를 따라가요.
The parrot says, "Follow me! Follow me!" So Tara follows it.

qs.q: "Soon she hears voices." What does "voices" mean here?
evs: Tall trees are everywhere, and strange birds call.
Then a red parrot lands on a branch.
She is hot, tired, and scared.
why: 바로 뒤에 «It is her camp!» 가 나와요. 캠프에 있는 사람들이 말하는 소리라는 뜻이에요.
The next sentence says it is her camp. "Voices" are the sounds of people talking at the camp.

qs.q: How does Tara find her camp?
opts: She climbs a tall tree and looks around.
She calls her mom on the phone.
She follows the parrot, and then she hears voices.
evs: Tall trees are everywhere, and strange birds call.
Tara follows the parrot over a river and under big leaves.
Tara is lost in the jungle.
why: 타라가 앵무새를 따라가다가, 곧 사람들 목소리를 들어요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Tara follows the parrot, and soon she hears voices. You need both sentences.

ends: Tara gives the red parrot some fruit to say thank you.
타라가 고맙다는 뜻으로 빨간 앵무새에게 과일을 준다.
The parrot teaches Tara the names of jungle animals.
앵무새가 타라에게 정글 동물들의 이름을 알려 준다.

write.src: “I think <u>the parrot is clever</u> because <u>it knows the way</u>.”
write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «내 생각 + 그 이유» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write your own idea and your reason in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: «because» 뒤에 «누가 + 무엇을» 넣어 이유를 분명하게 써 보세요. (예: because he is smiling)
write.moreEn: One more step: after «because», write who + what to make your reason clear. (e.g. because he is smiling)

img.cover: In a green jungle full of huge leaves, Tara, a girl with a long brown braid, a green explorer hat, a khaki shirt and brown boots, hops across round stepping stones over a small river, following a bright red parrot with blue wing tips that flies just ahead of her.

scenes.1: Deep in the jungle, Tara, a girl with a long brown braid, a green explorer hat, a khaki shirt and brown boots, sits tired on a tree root and looks up with hope at a bright red parrot with blue wing tips that lands on a branch above her and flaps its wings.
scenes.2: At a jungle camp with green tents and a small campfire, Tara, a girl with a long brown braid, a green explorer hat, a khaki shirt and brown boots, runs out from under big leaves toward smiling grown-ups waving at her, while a bright red parrot with blue wing tips sits proudly on her shoulder.

alt.1: A red parrot lands on a branch above tired Tara.
alt.2: Tara runs back to her camp with the parrot.
alt.cover: Tara follows a red parrot across a jungle river.
